field_scopes.id: Namespaced website-entry ID, never a native CLI argument.
field_scopes.native_cli_id: Only populated after exact upstream registry crosscheck; no default/fuzzy substitution.
field_scopes.channel_bandwidth_hz: Mode-page configured channel width; may span a scanner/bundle, not the minimum width of one emission.
field_scopes.minimum_bandwidth_hz: Null unless explicitly established as a minimum; not inferred from channel width.
field_scopes.sample_rate_minimum_sps: Mode-page lowest working rate claim, not a physical hardware acceptance result.
field_scopes.generator_status: Website listing and generated-signal test claims do not prove an exportable native generator.
field_scopes.kind: Editorial classification of the entry; tools, scans, navigation, scientific measurement and network inputs remain separate.
field_scopes.null: Unknown/absent public fact, never zero bandwidth/rate.
